card.title: You Can’t Leave Mid-Prophecy
card.instruction: Keep someone present until the impossible prediction has been fulfilled, disproved, or responsibly revised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay until sunset. Gran predicted this stone would hatch, and I promised we'd witness the result.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The sun's down. It's still a stone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then help me record that it didn't hatch. We can put the prophecy to rest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sign, but Gran never said which day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay while we ring her and agree a deadline. I can't witness every sunset alone.

mechanism: A keeps a witness involved until an impossible prediction receives a shared conclusion or an agreed deadline.
confusable: Unlike endless insistence that a prophecy must come true, A must pursue fulfillment, disproof or responsible revision.
comparison: An unspecified day leads to jointly calling Gran; the tower scene instead corrects a witness's fast watch.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
